annotations.title: A name to DFX ids, fast, across every private capital graph

description: A firm, fund, person or company name to canonical DFX ids across every private-capital graph, with the roles the same institution holds on other graphs (manager, adviser, lender, allocator). Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what it withheld.

domain.description: Comma-separated: family_office, independent_sponsor, venture_capital, private_equity, ria, allocators, private_credit, real_estate_funds. Default: all.

entity_type.description: Comma-separated graph types: organization, office, sponsor, capital_provider, fund, person, company.

name.description: The name, or a word of it (Blackstone, Horowitz, Thoma).

prefer_domain.description: The domain the question is about (same keys as domain, plus real_estate). Reorders, never filters: a row holding every asked word stays first, then rows in the preferred domain, then a real estate brand's primary adviser, then score. 'Blackstone' with real_estate_funds is Blackstone Real Estate Advisors with the brand's other advisers under `family`; 'Blackstone Management Partners' is still BMP.
